subject: general
question: Which type of paintings are found on the walls of Thiruvarur and Ajantha temples?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mural**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mural Paintings**

 
 
• **Mural paintings** are the only form of art that **truly alters and shares space, making them appear three-dimensional**.
 
• They must be painted on the** walls of big buildings like caverns and temples** since they are too big to fit on paper.
 
• The three main religious themes depicted by the paintings are **Hinduism, Buddhism, and Jainism**.
 
• Their **natural relationship to architecture and wide-ranging public importance** are two key characteristics that set them apart.
 
• The** colour pigments** used in ancient Indian mural paintings were made by combining natural materials like **chalk, terracotta, red ochre, and yellow ochre with animal fat**.
 
• Mural paintings can be found in places like** Ajanta, Thiruvarur, Bagh Caverns, Sittanavasal Caves, Kailasanatha Temple in Ellora, Armamalai Cave, and Ravan Chhaya Rock Shelter.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa63c2e557881fa6e2d68b7a753f64d6567982f5e81cf458096ead10c60dd194.png] **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ajanta Paintings **

 
 
• One of the **earliest existing murals on the Indian subcontinent **was carved out of volcanic rocks in the **4th century AD in the Ajanta caves**.
 
• It consists of **29 horseshoe-shaped caverns**.
 
• These caves are well-known for their **magnificent mural paintings**, which were produced during the **Mauryan Empire's rule **and took four to five centuries to complete.
 
• The paintings show the** social fabric and human ideals as well as historical fashions**.
